title: The Treatise of Living and Ending
summary: A treatise for those who hold both Life and Death that teaches how to hold a failing life in place and bring it back across its ending.

title: Canon of the Living Flame
summary: A canon for those who hold Life and Fire that joins vital warmth to flame to cauterize and cleanse and rebuild in one motion.

title: Treatise on Renewal Across Distance
summary: A treatise for those who hold Life and Space that folds the gap between healer and patient so renewal reaches the far wounded.

title: Canon of the Living Soul
summary: A canon for those who hold Life and Soul that mends body and spirit together and calls the spirit home to a fallen body.
